description: The Vivo T5X 5G in Cyber Green is built for users who demand powerful performance and exceptional battery life. Equipped with a massive 7200mAh battery, this smartphone ensures long hours of uninterrupted usage, making it perfect for heavy users, gamers, and content consumers. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo processor, combined with 8GB RAM, the device delivers smooth and responsive performance for multitasking, gaming, and everyday use. The 6.76-inch Full HD+ display with 120Hz refresh rate offers an immersive viewing experience with smooth scrolling and vibrant visuals. Capture stunning photos with the 50MP dual rear camera and enjoy high-quality selfies with the 32MP front camera. With its stylish Cyber Green finish and strong specifications, the Vivo T5X is designed to deliver both performance and premium looks.
